title: Jump loci of fibre cohomology of a perfect complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be a pseudo-coherent complex [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex] in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] (for example, a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex]). For each integer $i$ define $\beta_i(x)=\dim_{\kappa(x)}H^i(Li_x^*E)$ for $x\in X$. Then formation of $\beta_i$ commutes with arbitrary base change, each $\beta_i$ is upper semicontinuous, and every level set of $\beta_i$ is locally constructible.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma jump-loci, Tag 0BDI

proof.text: For each x, apply the local one-degree finite free model theorem. Apply finiteFreeComplex_homology_upperSemicontinuous to its bounded finite free algebraic complex K. The model equality identifies beta_i on U with the returned function beta pulled back along the chart homeomorphism. Pulling back the strict sublevel opens gives local upper semicontinuity.

For each natural r on the chart, express {beta = r} as {beta < r+1} minus {beta < r}, using integer thresholds. The two strict sublevel sets are compact opens by the finite-free homology theorem; Mathlib IsCompact.isConstructible on the spectral prime spectrum and IsConstructible.sdiff make their difference constructible. Pull it back along the open embedding of the homeomorphism. The open charts are neighbourhoods, so this gives IsLocallyConstructible on X. For upper semicontinuity on X, at each point of a strict sublevel set take the image of the corresponding local strict sublevel open under the open subtype inclusion. This open image is contained in the global strict sublevel and contains the point.

For arbitrary g and y obtain the derived-fibre scalar extension isomorphism. Its associated linear equivalence preserves finrank. Give kappa(y) its algebra structure from g.residueFieldMap y and apply Mathlib Module.finrank_baseChange, which applies to every vector space over the field kappa(g y), finite-dimensional or otherwise. Package this equality, global upper semicontinuity, and local constructibility.

lean.statement: theorem pseudoCoherent_jump_loci (X : Scheme.{uX}) [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPseudoCoherent X E) (i : ℤ) : (∀ (Y : Scheme.{uX}) [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ y : Y, HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings (Spec (Y.residueField y)).toRingedSpace))] (g : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y), derivedFiberBetti Y ((derivedPullback g).obj E) i y = derivedFiberBetti X E i (g y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuous (derivedFiberBetti X E i) ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, Topology.IsLocallyConstructible {x : X | derivedFiberBetti X E i x = r}
